title: Multiplexed Detection of Antibody Binding to Hemagglutinin by Flow Cytometry
author: Ullrich, Daniel, et al.
materials: BD OptiBuild™ BV711 Mouse Anti-Human IgG

steps.title: Thaw and recover HEK293‑6E cells
steps.instruction: Thaw one cryovial (1 × 10⁷ cells/mL) in a 37 °C water bath until a small ice crystal remains, transfer to 45 mL pre‑warmed FreeStyle™ 293 Expression Medium, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min at 20–25 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL pre‑warmed medium, incubate at 37 °C, 6 % CO₂, shaking 110 rpm in a 125 mL vented flask; monitor density daily for 1–2 weeks, keep ≤0.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL, passage every other day to 0.3 × 10⁶ cells/mL (or 0.2 × 10⁶ cells/mL before weekends); use cells after ≥3 passages with ≥60 % transfection efficiency, discard overgrown cultures (>1.8 × 10⁶ cells/mL) and thaw fresh vial if efficiency drops.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend in 10 mL medium.
Passage every other day to 0.3 × 10⁶ cells/mL (0.2 × 10⁶ before weekends).
Use after ≥3 passages with ≥60 % transfection efficiency.

steps.title: Adjust cell density for transfection
steps.instruction: Adjust recovered HEK293‑6E cells to 0.8 × 10⁶ cells/mL in fresh FreeStyle™ 293 medium and equilibrate 1 h at 37 °C, 6 % CO₂, 110 rpm before transfection.

steps.title: Prepare transfection mix
steps.instruction: For each HA‑encoding plasmid, add the appropriate volume of DPBS to a tube, add the required amount of plasmid DNA and mix by pipetting, add PEI working solution, vortex 30 s, incubate 10 min at 20–25 °C, then add the mixture dropwise to the cells while gently swirling. Use separate batches for each HA plasmid; do not co‑transfect multiple plasmids.

substeps.instruction: Add DPBS to tube (volume per recipe).
Add plasmid DNA, mix by pipetting.
Add PEI working solution, vortex 30 s.
Add dropwise to cells while gently swirling.

steps.title: Transfect cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mixture to the cells, incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 6 % CO₂, shaking 250 rpm for 24‑deepwell plates (or 110 rpm for vented Erlenmeyer flasks). Optionally examine fluorescence microscopy 24 h after transfection to assess expression.

steps.title: Harvest transfected cells
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend each culture, transfer to a conical tube, add 2 vol FACS buffer relative to culture volume, mix, centrifuge 400 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, decant supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 mL FACS buffer per 5 mL initial culture, count cells and adjust to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in FACS buffer, dispense 60 µL of each fluorescent‑protein cell population into designated wells of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate (3 × 60 µL per well for three antigens), store plate at 4 °C protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend culture and transfer to tube.
Resuspend in 2 mL FACS buffer per 5 mL culture.
Dispense 60 µL of each cell population into assay plate.

steps.title: Prepare serial dilutions of samples
steps.instruction: In a separate 96‑well V‑bottom plate, add 121.9 µL PBS to rows B–D and F–H, add 130 µL of each sample (sera diluted 1:20 in PBS or monoclonal antibody at 25 µg/mL) to rows A and E, include a known HA‑binding monoclonal antibody (e.g., CR6261) as positive control, then perform a 1:16 serial dilution by transferring 8.1 µL from A→B (and E→F), mixing 5×, and repeating transfers B→C→D (and F→G→H) with mixing after each step, yielding ≥100 µL (e.g., 130 µL) per well.

steps.title: Wash cells after harvesting
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the assay plate at 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and aspirate supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet (use an 8‑channel vacuum manifold or multichannel pipette).

steps.title: Add samples to cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of each prepared serial dilution to the corresponding wells containing cell pellets, resuspend by pipetting, incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: First wash after sample incubation
steps.instruction: Add 190 µL FACS buffer to each well, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Second wash after sample incubation
steps.instruction: Add 290 µL FACS buffer to each well, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Stain with detection antibody
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL BD OptiBuild™ BV711 Mouse Anti‑Human IgG diluted 1:300 in FACS buffer, mix by pipetting up and down 5 times, incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after detection antibody
steps.instruction: Repeat the two wash steps: add 190 µL then 290 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C each, aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Stain with live/dead marker
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL Zombie NIR™ diluted 1:600 in PBS, mix by pipetting up and down 5 times, incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after live/dead staining
steps.instruction: Repeat the two wash steps (190 µL then 290 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate).

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL BD Fixation buffer (4 % PFA), incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Final washes and resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash twice with 290 µL FACS buffer (centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C each), then resuspend cells in 120 µL FACS buffer, seal plate tightly and store at 4 °C protected from light until flow cytometry acquisition.

steps.title: Prepare unstained control
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL HA‑only cells to a FACS tube, store at 4 °C protected from light until fixation.

steps.title: Prepare fluorescent protein single‑stain controls
steps.instruction: For each antigen‑fluorescent protein combination, add 400 µL fluorescent‑protein‑expressing cells plus 200 µL HA‑only cells to a FACS tube, store at 4 °C protected from light until fixation.

steps.title: Prepare detection antibody single‑stain control
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL HA‑only cells to a FACS tube, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 400 µL HA‑binding monoclonal antibody (100 µg/mL), resuspend and incubate 30 min at 4 °C; wash twice with 2 mL FACS buffer (centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C each), resuspend in 400 µL detection antibody diluted 1:300 in FACS buffer, incubate 30 min at 4 °C; wash once as before, add 200 µL HA‑only cells + 300 µL FACS buffer, resuspend by pipetting 5 times, store at 4 °C protected from light until fixation.

steps.title: Prepare live/dead single‑stain control
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL HA‑only cells to a FACS tube, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 600 µL Zombie NIR diluted 1:600 in PBS, incubate 30 min at 4 °C, wash with 2 mL FACS buffer (centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C), decant, resuspend in 300 µL FACS buffer, store at 4 °C protected from light until fixation.

steps.title: Prepare fluorescent protein gating controls (live/dead‑only)
steps.instruction: For each antigen‑fluorescent protein combination, add 200 µL fluorescent‑protein‑expressing cells to a FACS tube, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 200 µL Zombie NIR diluted 1:600 in PBS, incubate 30 min at 4 °C, wash with 2 mL FACS buffer (centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C), decant, resuspend in 300 µL FACS buffer, store at 4 °C protected from light until fixation.

steps.title: Fix all control cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge each control tube 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 400 µL BD fixation buffer (4 % PFA), incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Wash fixed controls
steps.instruction: Wash each fixed control twice with 2 mL FACS buffer (centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 4 °C each), decant supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension of controls
steps.instruction: Resuspend each control in 250 µL FACS buffer, filter into FACS tubes, store at 4 °C protected from light (up to 1 week, preferably within 2 days) until flow cytometry acquisition.

steps.title: Set up flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Configure the BD LSRFortessa with High‑Throughput Sampler according to manufacturer instructions, load compensation controls, adjust detector voltages using the controls, and calculate a new compensation matrix.

steps.title: Filter samples before acquisition
steps.instruction: Pass each 96‑well plate through a 40 µm filter plate, pulse‑spin at 400 × g, and transfer samples to a fresh V‑bottom plate for acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire data
steps.instruction: Acquire each well using standard throughput mode with sample flow rate 3, sample volume 60 µL, mixing volume 50 µL, mixing speed 180 µL/s, 3 mixes, wash volume 400 µL, BLR on (period 50), and stop after recording 10 000 viable cells per well.

steps.title: Apply gating strategy
steps.instruction: Gate FSC‑A vs SSC‑A for main cell population, FSC‑A vs FSC‑H for singlets, FSC‑A vs APC‑Cy7 for Zombie NIR‑negative viable cells; then gate each fluorescent protein (mTagBFP2 with BV421, sfGFP with FITC, dTomato with PE) using the respective single‑color controls; finally gate BV711‑positive events within each fluorescent‑protein gate using live/dead‑only controls, setting the BV711 threshold so 0.1‑0.5 % of negative‑control events fall within the gate.

steps.title: Analyze binding data
steps.instruction: Export the percentage of BV711‑positive cells (or BV711 MFI) for each sample, plot versus antibody concentration (µg/mL) or reciprocal dilution, fit a four‑parameter logistic curve to obtain EC50 (monoclonal antibodies) or ED50 (sera/plasma); exclude data lacking dynamic range or with high replicate variability, and average technical replicates before reporting.
